headline: Executive order creates two new military medals for service in the Afghanistan and Iraq campaigns.
what_it_does: This order creates the Afghanistan Campaign Medal and the Iraq Campaign Medal. These awards recognize members of the U.S. armed forces who served in military operations in those two countries. The details of who qualifies, such as required time or location of service, are set by the Secretary of Defense and military rules, not by the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the U.S. armed forces who served in Afghanistan or Iraq
who_it_affects.how: They may become eligible to receive a campaign medal recognizing that service.

who_it_affects.group: Department of Defense and military services
who_it_affects.how: They are responsible for setting rules for and handing out the new medals.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 29, 2004; exact effective date and eligibility periods not stated in the title.
